Mock 2 · A table: purpose styling and growth
Cells are tinted by purpose; a bar under each header shows it. Purpose is
per column (header menu) and defaults to the table's purpose.
Calculated columns use Excel's table notation: =[@Units]*[@[Unit price]].
Typing in the dashed row below extends the table. Queries and charts that
read Sales pick the new row up.
